newsitem.title: UK: OPEC producers say they pumped 24.69 mbpd in Nov.
newsitem.headline: OPEC producers say they pumped 24.69 mbpd in Nov.

text.p: OPEC pumped 24.690 million barrels per day (bpd) at the wellhead during November, according to latest data provided by member countries to the OPEC secretariat.

The member country data compared to estimates from media sources, including Reuters, which put OPEC's 11-member output at 26.033 million bpd, well in advance of the official 25.033 million ceiling, the OPEC news agency said.
Venezuela, reporting figures to OPEC's Vienna-based Secretariat for the first time in months, said it produced 2.385 million bpd, marginally above its 2.359 million quota.
Caracas had declined to provide figures since the first quarter this year in protest at the secretariat's use of secondary media estimates for comparison versus member country data.
Venezuela produced 3.11 million bpd in November, according to media estimates published by OPEC, 725,000 bpd higher than Venezuela's own submission.
Caracas has not yet provided a supply to market figure for November.

OPEC quotas are based on supply to market rather than wellhead production. Supply to market is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawals of stocks held outside national boundaries.
